units.translation: the work of this right hand
subdued by a treacherous fate from a hand with a two-edged weapon
paying the price for the contrivances of a father's hand (Triclinius rightly reads χειρός)
the one who is lorded over by another's hand
the work of your hand
the reachings of the hand
and truly in battle the daughter of Zeus touched his hand
for the blood slumbers and wastes away from the hand
having conquered with his hand
with a wretched and villainous hand
nor does he have pollution upon his hand
cutting the throat with a sword-drawing hand
and Zeus, laying on with his hand, begets offspring
and now I leave them to your hand and your words
having held him with a healing hand
he accomplished twin evils with a father-slaying hand
I stood at the altar with a sacrificial hand
to carry with this hand
an avenger with spear and hand
but you, instead of speech, indicate with a barbarian hand
they do not sleep with their hand
and I have not been housed with a small hand
bright-eyed toward the hand
and he stretches forth hand from hand (M reads χειρός) as reachings
nor did I stretch out my hand for the carrying out of the corpse
grant that I myself become far more chaste than my mother, and my hand more reverent
and when would Zeus, flourishing on both sides, lay his hand upon her?
may they not keep their hands away from us
when the king's dear hand has come
not a suppliant's hand nor one unwashed of blood
a hand that watches from below
and brandishing in his hands a fire-breathing missile
throwing her arms around him she will kiss him
and fetters for hands and feet, a pair
not holding a boast in his hands
a rhythmic beat of the hands for escort
with her hands she tears apart the chariot's trappings
with my hands I touched the fair-flowing spring
and Ares, brandishing in his hands back-bent missiles
accomplishing his fated lot with his hands and a staff that persuades mortals
for the blood is still fresh upon your hands
having poured it over his hands
but the hands of those in power are not holy
and the torch blazes, armed through the hands (thus rightly M, not χεροίν, which is in my edition)
holding suppliant branches reverently in their left hands
with womanish upturnings of the hands
when the gods receive sacrifice from their hands
men have died by their own murderous hands
for does a bow-drawing spear through their hands (thus Brunckius for χερός) befit them?
they were struck with stones from their hands
with the edge of their hands
the vision passed through their hands, shifting
with the dirt of their hands
the tips of the fingers
by the will of our hands
slaughtered by mother-killing hands
he wishes to become liable to justice for his hands
776 and you took me from my hands
taking him in his arms with mighty strength he struck him with a hammer
touching with their hands the bull's blood
and they crowned memorials of themselves with their hands
they died by each other's kindred, murderous hands
tearing their veils with tender hands
and I run with my hands
the air bristled with right hands
the Argive people accomplished it with their hands
holding silkworm cocoons in his hands
with ambidextrous hands: those of the archers; because each hand works in shooting. Aeschylus in Telephus (fr. 237).
that the Cadmean men came to blows with the Argives in sufficient numbers
filling their hands with meat
dripping blood from their hands
the one holding out clean hands
